title: Introduction
body_text:
Thank you for participating to this experiment.

You will have to perform a series of tasks which will consist in identyfing patterns in images. Your goal is to maximize your performance, by trying to provide the right answer for every image. Your bonus financial reward will depend on your overall performance during the main experimental phase.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.
button_text: I read and understood the instructions

title: Let's jump in
body_text:
Before giving you further instructions, you will perform a first training task in order to discover the interface. This task will not count towards your score and remuneration, and the results will not be recorded. You will be presented with a series of 3 images of symbols of colors, and you will have to answer a question pertaining to each of the images. For this task and few other tasks of the Introduction, you will be informed if the decision was right or wrong after each decision.

As for every task later, the question will be the same for every image of the task. The question will usually change every new task, except for the tasks of the Discovery and Acclimatation sequences of the Introduction.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.

title: Protocol structure
body_text:
The protocol will last about 35 minutes and is organized as follows.


To continue your familiarization with the task and the interface, you will enter the acclimation phase, which consists of two tasks of 5 images each.

Then, you will start the preparation phase for the main experiment, which will consist of 2 tasks of 7 questions each. The tasks will be very similar to the tasks of the main experiment. This phase will conclude the introduction

Then, the main experiment will start. It will be divided into 2 main sessions. Each session consists in solving 4 tasks of 14 questions each, that will count towards your score and bonus remuneration. Every 2 tasks, you will have to answer a small survey about the tasks you just performed.

Finally, you will enter the closing phase, in which you will have to answer a final survey to conclude the protocol.

Please note that your actions and answers will only be recorded during the Main experimental phase and the Closing phase, and that the tasks that count towards your performance and bonus remuneration are all part of the Main experimental phase.

Please read the information above carefully, as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.

title: Introduction - Main experiment preparation
body_text:
You are now entering the preparation phase for the Main experiment, which is the last phase of the Introduction. You are about to perform 2 tasks of 7 questions each. These tasks closely resemble those in the main experimental phase and are intended to help you practice and prepare for the main task.

As in the main experimental phase, you will have a limited amount of time to respond to each question. The allotted time for each question of this training task is 45 seconds, and it will be shorter for the evaluated tasks in the main experiment.

As this is still a training phase, your answers will not be recorded and your score will not count towards your bonus remuneration.

title: Main experiment
body_text:
The introduction is over. You are now entering the main experimental phase, in which your answers as well as your performance at the tasks will be recorded. Your performance during this phase will count towards your bonus remuneration. As a reminder, the structure of the experiment is described in the diagram below.


This phase is divided in 2 sessions. In each session, you must perform 2 tasks, answer a first survey about those tasks, then you must perform another 2 tasks and answer a second survey about those 2 latter tasks. There are no right or wrong answers to the survey questions; only your score during the tasks will count towards your bonus remuneration.

Note that you will not be given your score anymore at the end of each task. Your score on all tasks of the main experimental phase will be given to you at the end of the protocol.

Please read the information above carefully as you will not be able to return to this page once you click the button below. You can take notes if you wish to.

title: Closing phase
body_text: Thank you for completing all the tasks. Before terminating the protocol, you will complete a final survey (several pages).

questions.primary_text: For each statement listed below, select the proposition that indicates the extent to which you feel it is characteristic of you. For example, if the statement is not at all like you, select number (1) “Extremely Uncharacteristic,” or if you really can’t decide if the statement is or is not characteristic of you, select number (3) “Uncertain”.<hr>
questions.secondary_text: I would prefer complex to simple problems.
